description: Give a customer a company role in the company they belong to now. Roles come from the workspace's catalogue; v1 has two: 'admin' sees every order placed for the company, 'buyer' (the default) only their own. The role holds only while the customer stays in that company - moved to another, they are buyer there. Refused when the customer has no company, and for a key outside the catalogue. Returns the customer with companyRole as the effective role.

role.description: A role key from the workspace's company role catalogue - v1: 'admin' or 'buyer'

name: set_customer_company_role
title: Set customer company role
